main_text.p: כפַּר Chald. Ligare, vincire, constringere. Pahel כַּפַּר Idem.
כִּיפְּתָא Ch. Vinculû, Cippus. Idem quod Rabbinis כְּפָּה.

כרא כְּרָה Ch. Fodere, effodere, perfodere: Item Syr. Dolere, infirmari, debilitari, cotristari, Ithpeh. אִתְכְּרִי Fodi, perfodi, transfodi: Syr. ܐܬܟܪܝ Infirmari, debilitari, ægritudine affici, ad Rom. 4. 19. Act. 9.36. Hinc Ch. וְלָא אִכְרָהִית Et non dolui, Prov. 23.35. Item Abbreviari, decurtari, Matt.24.22. Pah.
ܟܪܒ Syr. Abbreviare, decurtare, Mar.13.19.20. Aph.
ܐܟܪܒ Tristitiâ, mœrore afficere, contristare, 2. ad Cor. 2.1.2.5.
כְּרִיהָ כְּרִיָּא Ch. Brevis, abbreviatus, præceps, Prov.14. 17.29. Syr. Tristis, mœstus: ܟܪܝܐ ܟܪܝܐ Tristis; de verbo ad verbum, Cùm doleret ei, Matt. 19. 22. Sic Mar. 3.5.
ܟܪܝܐ Syr. Ægrotus, infirmus, Joh. 5.7. Absque ܟܪܝܐ, 1.ad Tim.6.4.Sic 2.ad Tim.4.20.Pl. ܟܪܝܐ Ægroti, Joh.5.v.3.Cū Af. ܟܪܝܐ Mat.14.14.
ܟܪܝܐ ܟܪܝܐ Syr. Tristitia, mœror, ægritudo, dolor, infirmitas.

ܟܪܝܐ Syr. Infirmitas, ægritudo, morbus, languor. Plur. ܟܪܝܐ, Luc. 7.21. Hinc in T. תְּסוֹבֵר כּוּרְחָנָה Sustetat infirmitatem ejus, Prov. 18.14. וּמְנַטְּלִין בִּכְרִיּוּתִיהּ וּכְרִיוּתָא Numer. 24.6. in Targ. Hierof.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac characters are only approximated in this transcription; several Syriac and Hebrew forms are uncertain and not reliably reproduced. Catchword/signature "L1" is printed at the foot centre.
